identitySignals: The OUSD Measure G1 page says the Commission advises and reports to the OUSD Board of Education and oversees parcel tax spending.
The agenda item is a Measure G1 middle school grant application and education spending plan. This matches the purpose of the Measure G1 parcel tax.
research.notes: The Measure G1 Commission looks like an internal oversight body of OUSD itself, not a separate vendor. It was created by the Measure G1 parcel tax. I found no separate legal entity, EIN, California entity number, SAM.gov UEI, website, phone or email for it. The OUSD page I fetched (ousd.org/community/parcel-taxes/measure-g1) shows no commission contact details. I did not build a profile, because the details would be OUSD's own and could mislead readers. A reviewer should treat this entry as an OUSD body and not as an outside organization.
